title: Rock types · GLiM
notice: Surface lithology, not geological age or a subsurface section. Regional source detail varies; close zoom does not add detail.

classes.name: Unconsolidated sediments
classes.description: Loose sediments such as sand, clay and gravel.

classes.name: Siliciclastic sedimentary
classes.description: Sedimentary rocks dominated by silicate fragments, including sandstone and shale.

classes.name: Mixed sedimentary
classes.description: Mixed siliciclastic and carbonate sedimentary rocks.

classes.name: Carbonate sedimentary
classes.description: Carbonate-rich sedimentary rocks, including limestone and dolomite.

classes.name: Evaporites
classes.description: Rocks deposited through evaporation, including rock salt and gypsum.

classes.name: Pyroclastic rocks
classes.description: Rocks made from fragments ejected by volcanic eruptions.

classes.name: Volcanic · silica-rich
classes.description: Acid volcanic rocks in the source classification; examples include rhyolite.

classes.name: Volcanic · intermediate
classes.description: Intermediate volcanic rocks; examples include andesite.

classes.name: Volcanic · silica-poor
classes.description: Basic volcanic rocks in the source classification; examples include basalt.

classes.name: Plutonic · silica-rich
classes.description: Acid plutonic rocks formed underground; examples include granite.

classes.name: Plutonic · intermediate
classes.description: Intermediate plutonic rocks formed underground; examples include diorite.

classes.name: Plutonic · silica-poor
classes.description: Basic plutonic rocks formed underground; examples include gabbro.

classes.name: Metamorphic rocks
classes.description: Rocks altered by heat, pressure or fluids.

classes.name: Water bodies
classes.description: Areas classified as water, rather than exposed rock.

classes.name: Ice / glaciers
classes.description: Ice-covered areas, rather than exposed rock.

classes.name: No data
classes.description: Unknown or unmapped lithology; no rock type is inferred.
